contentComplete.description: Fires when a learner completes course content or assessment, recording the course, learner profile, authentication state, and completion timestamp.

page.description: Records page context including the primary and secondary category, language, page ID and name for the educational content in the current request.

user.description: Records learner profile including profile ID, username, authentication state, learner role, subscription plan, account ID, access entitlements, and engagement level.

video_progress.description: Fires during video playback to track learner progress through video content, recording course context, learner profile, and subscription details.

select_content.description: Fires when a learner selects or navigates to specific learning content within the platform.

user_engagement.description: Fires to record learner engagement activity, capturing course, lesson, content, module, and activity details.
